lessons.title: Story Time: A Day at the Seaside
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss events in a seaside-themed story.
success_criteria: I can say what happened at the seaside.
I can say how the character felt.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a seaside-themed story, modelling discussion of events and feelings.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer questions about the story's events and feelings.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of events/feelings — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a time you visited the seaside.

lessons.title: Addition and Subtraction: Seaside Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve mixed word problems using a seaside context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using a seaside context (e.g. shells collected).
lessons.independent_task: Children solve seaside-themed word problems, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record word problem solving skill — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up a seaside word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Seaside Holidays in the Past
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a feature of seaside holidays in the past.
success_criteria: I can name something people did at the seaside long ago.
I can describe how it's different from today.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at an old seaside holiday photograph.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss features of seaside holidays in the past (donkey rides, bathing machines, formal dress).
lessons.independent_task: Children record facts about seaside holidays in the past using picture evidence.
key_questions: What did people wear at the seaside long ago?
What did they do for fun?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note historical enquiry using photographic evidence — evidence for HIST.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap seaside holidays in the past.
lessons.home_link: Ask a family member about a seaside holiday they remember.

lessons.title: What Is a Coast?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe features of a coastline using geographical vocabulary.
success_criteria: I can name a coastal feature.
I can use a geography word (beach, cliff, coast).
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a coastal picture and discuss what's there.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss coastal features using geographical vocabulary (beach, cliff, coast, tide).
lessons.independent_task: Children label a coastal picture with key features.
key_questions: What is this part of the coast called?

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain the formation of each feature simply

lessons.assessment_notes: Note geographical vocabulary use — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a coast or beach you've visited.

lessons.title: Using 'But' to Compare Then and Now
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to join two contrasting seaside ideas using 'but'.
success_criteria: I can complete a sentence using 'but'.
I can write my own sentence comparing then and now.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap seaside holidays then and now.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model constructing 'but' sentences comparing seaside holidays then and now.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 2-3 'but' sentences comparing seaside holidays then and now.
key_questions: What is different between then and now?
Can you join your ideas with 'but'?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note use of conjunctions for contrast — evidence for ENG.W3.
lessons.home_link: Make up a 'but' sentence comparing two things at home.

lessons.title: Telling Time Recap: O'Clock and Half Past
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to tell the time to the hour and half hour confidently.
success_criteria: I can read o'clock times.
I can read half past times.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Recap reading o'clock and half past times using a demonstration clock.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise reading and setting mixed o'clock/half past times, linked to a seaside day timetable.
key_questions: What time does this clock show?
What could you do at this time at the seaside?

differentiation.greater_depth: Mix o'clock and half past confidently

lessons.assessment_notes: Record time-telling consolidation — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Practise telling the time on a clock at home.

lessons.title: Seaside Toys and Games Then and Now
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare seaside toys/games from the past to today.
success_criteria: I can name a seaside toy/game from the past.
I can compare it to one used today.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap toy comparisons from the Autumn topic.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss seaside toys then and now (e.g. metal buckets vs plastic, simple spades vs elaborate sandcastle kits).
lessons.independent_task: Children compare a seaside toy from the past to one from today, recording similarities/differences.
resources_needed: Old and new seaside toy picture cards
key_questions: What is the same about these toys?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note direct comparison skill, linking back to Week 4's toy comparison learning — evidence for HIST.1.
lessons.plenary: Share comparisons made with the class.
lessons.home_link: Compare a seaside toy you have to what a family member had.

lessons.title: Famous UK Seaside Towns
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name and locate a UK seaside town.
success_criteria: I can name a UK seaside town.
I can find it roughly on a map.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the UK map from Week 28.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce a few famous UK seaside towns (e.g. Blackpool, Brighton, Scarborough) on a map.
lessons.independent_task: Children mark a seaside town on a UK map outline, noting one fact about it.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note locational knowledge extended to UK seaside towns — evidence for GEOG.1.
lessons.home_link: Find a seaside town on a map together.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Seaside Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read seaside-themed words.
success_criteria: I can blend and read seaside words.
I can read a sentence about the seaside.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce/reinforce a grapheme, blending seaside-themed words (e.g. 'beach', 'shell', 'wave').
lessons.independent_task: Children read seaside-themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading seaside words over the week.

lessons.title: Sandcastle Shapes
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify 3D shapes used in sandcastle building.
success_criteria: I can name a 3D shape.
I can say how it's used in a sandcastle.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss 3D shapes used in sandcastle building (cylinder buckets, cone towers, cube blocks).
lessons.independent_task: Children design a sandcastle using labelled 3D shapes.
key_questions: What shape is this part of your sandcastle?
How many faces does it have?

differentiation.greater_depth: Use 4+ shapes and describe their properties

lessons.assessment_notes: Note 3D shape recognition applied to a design context — evidence for MATHS.GEO.
lessons.home_link: Look for 3D shapes in buckets, boxes or containers at home.

lessons.title: Travelling to the Seaside: Then and Now
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how travel to the seaside has changed.
success_criteria: I can say how people travelled to the seaside in the past.
I can say how we travel there now.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how children have travelled to the seaside.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss how travel to the seaside has changed (trains historically, cars/trains today).
lessons.independent_task: Children compare old and new seaside travel methods, recording one change.
resources_needed: Old and new travel picture cards
key_questions: How did people travel to the seaside long ago?
How do we travel there now?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give reasoning for why travel has changed

lessons.assessment_notes: Note change over time understanding — evidence for HIST.1.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how your family travels to the seaside.

lessons.title: Postcard from the Seaside: Speaking
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe an imagined seaside day clearly to a partner.
success_criteria: I can describe what I did at the seaside.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap seaside activities discussed this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model describing an imagined seaside day using full sentences.
lessons.independent_task: Children describe their imagined seaside day to a partner, answering a question.
resources_needed: Seaside activity picture cards for prompts
key_questions: What did you do at the seaside?

differentiation.greater_depth: Describe unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language progress — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Describe a real or imagined seaside day to your family.

lessons.title: Number Consolidation: Seaside Counting Challenge
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting, ordering and comparing skills to a seaside context.
success_criteria: I can count a set of seaside objects.
I can order and compare numbers.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model a mixed counting challenge using seaside-themed objects.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed seaside counting, ordering and comparing challenge.
lessons.assessment_notes: Consolidation check on number skills across the year — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.home_link: Practise counting seaside-themed objects or pictures.

lessons.title: Seaside Weather and Tides
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how the tide changes a beach.
success_criteria: I can say what a tide is.
I can describe how the beach changes with the tide.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at pictures of a beach at high and low tide.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss tides simply — the sea moves in and out, changing the beach.
lessons.independent_task: Children compare high tide and low tide pictures, recording what's different.
key_questions: What is different about the beach at high tide?

differentiation.support: Compare with adult support, one difference
differentiation.greater_depth: Explain why tides matter for seaside safety

lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of tidal change, a coastal geography concept — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap high and low tide differences.
lessons.home_link: Look up tide times for a coast near you if possible.

lessons.title: Seaside Then and Now Quiz
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about seaside holidays then and now.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about seaside holidays then and now, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: How did people dress at the seaside long ago?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on seaside facts you learned.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Time, Shape, Number
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply time, shape and number skills learned this week.
success_criteria: I can tell the time.
I can name 3D shapes.
I can count and compare.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of time-telling, 3D shapes, and number skills.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through 3 stations covering each skill.
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 33 maths observations for each child — evidence for MATHS.MEA/GEO/N1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising telling the time over the weekend.

lessons.title: Seaside Holidays Topic Recap and Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about seaside holidays then and now.
success_criteria: I can name a way seaside holidays have changed.
I can name a way they've stayed the same.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's history and geography learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss synthesising the week's learning about seaside holidays then and now.
lessons.independent_task: Contribute to a class 'Seaside Then and Now' display combining photographs, toy comparisons, and travel facts from the week.
key_questions: What have we learned about seaside holidays?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for HIST.1/GEOG.1/GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Unveil the finished 'Seaside Then and Now' display.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about seaside holidays with your family.
